environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS EKS cluster (v1.27) in namespace 'default'. Pod runs with default service account. No NetworkPolicy objects applied to the namespace. IMDSv1 enabled on EC2 worker nodes (HttpTokens: optional). Pod can reach 169.254.169.254 without restriction. WebSocket endpoint exposed via AWS ALB Ingress Controller with no WAF attached.
